description: Returns one application to the Tbilisi Architecture Service by its number (AR11168188): the address, the status, the category, the class, the stages, the deadline, the executor, the text of the decision, and the link to its page. Find a number with permits_search_applications. Texts are in Georgian. Data from TAS.
name: permits_get_application

action.description: The action, in Georgian, as a change of an approved project.

address.description: The address, in Georgian, as TAS publishes it.

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the application, RFC 3339.

category.description: The kind of object or work, in Georgian.

class.description: The class of risk, I to IV.

deadline.description: The date by which TAS must answer, YYYY-MM-DD.

decision_text.description: The text of the decision of TAS, in Georgian, with no HTML. Empty before a decision.

executor.description: The employee of TAS who handles the application.

parent_category.description: The group of the category, in Georgian.

source.description: The source of the data: TAS.

stages.description: The stages that the application covers, in Georgian.

stale.description: True when TAS did not answer and the server returns an application it read before.

status.description: approved, refused, deficient, conditional, not_reviewed, revoked, completed, awaiting_payment, or in_review.

name.description: The name of the code at TAS, in Georgian.

url.description: The page of the application on tas.ge.

title: Get a building application of Tbilisi
